subsystem.name: VehiclePhysics
subsystem.responsibility: Coordinate-frame math and global solver-state lifecycle: computeInverse3x3CoordinateTransform transforms forces/vectors between coordinate frames (3x3 inverse matrix built from cofactors and matrix-vector products), and PhysicsStateZeroInit zero-initializes a large global physics/dynamics solver state region.

summary: Two vehicle-physics functions. (1) computeInverse3x3CoordinateTransform (0x0056D020, owner MatrixTransformWorkspace, DERIVED) reads matrix/vector blocks from its workspace, transforms two input vectors with Matrix3x3VectorMultiply, computes cofactor-based inverse-matrix rows and additional matrix-vector products into the result buffer at this+0x10, and returns a pointer into that buffer; callers at 0x00439210 and 0x0056D930 depend on it. (2) PhysicsStateZeroInit (0x00579CCF, owner PhysicsSolverState, GUESS grouping) zero-initializes a large contiguous global solver-state region: 24 named doubles set directly to 0.0 and 34 blocks (24..272 bytes) cleared through sub_58BB10, returning the result of the final 272-byte block clear. No callers recorded for the zero-init; per-block semantics and the header/padding fields this+0x18 / this+0x20 remain unestablished.
